blocks.html:
Small Decals (Racing Stripes)

Have you thought about adding racing stripes, logos or stickers to your vehicle? Any small decals can really add to the overall look of your vehicle. This customer bought this 2020 Mercedes AMG C63S and decided to personalize it. The first time he stopped by the Vinyl Wrap Toronto garage was to get the door handles wrapped to match the rest of the car. They were done with a chrome finish from the factory.

While here he spoke to our installation crew about his other personalization ideas. The customer decided to go with the racing stripes. The red stripes on the side mirrors and lower sides were quick to install and make a huge difference to the overall look of the vehicle. The red was chosen by the client to make the brake callipers. The small hint of red decals on the side mirrors adds personalization and shows the owner really thought about the final look.

Click here (Portfolio) to view more of our work.

Speak to our installation team about your personalization ideas and dream at 416-746-1381 whether they are small decals, logos, or racing stripes.
